broken.what: After tapping Next on the statement step, the counter still says 'Step 1 of 3' while step 2 is active. After leaving and returning, the same state shows 'Step 2 of 3'. The progress count does not update on statement-only steps.
The test question asks the student to 'Find f⁻¹(x)', but step 1 simply states f⁻¹(x) = (x+1)/4 with no answer box. The marked part of the question is given away in a topic test.

looks_wrong.what: The test status line ('Topic test · question 1 of 10' / 'Good — keep going.') is half hidden under the sticky top header.
The status line under the header is clipped: only 'question 1 of 10' and later 'going.' are visible, and the pencil icon is cut off.
The 'Take the topic test →' button is cut off at the bottom edge, and the Algebra title is scrolled under the header.
The progress bar reads 'Step 1 of 3' even though step 1 is done and step 2 is open.
The 'Next question' button is cut off at the bottom of the screen.

would_quit.quote: The denominator of f⁻¹(x) is 4. Find the numerator when x = 7.
would_quit.why: The wording ('denominator', 'numerator' of a function) is confusing after being handed the formula with no explanation, so the student gave up and left the test.

fixes.target: Topic test step progress: behaviour on statement/Next steps
fixes.change: Advance the 'Step n of N' counter and the progress bar when Next is tapped on a no-input step, so it shows 'Step 2 of 3' immediately.
Replace the stated answer with an input step, e.g. 'Let y = 4x − 1. Rearrange to make x the subject. What do you add to both sides first?' so the student actually finds f⁻¹(x).
Reword to 'f⁻¹(7) = (7 + 1)/4. Work out 7 + 1.', followed by step 3 'Now divide by 4', instead of the 'denominator/numerator' phrasing.

fixes.target: Topic test page layout (status bar under sticky header)
fixes.change: Add top padding/scroll offset equal to the header height so 'Topic test · question X of 10' and the feedback line are fully visible below the header on phone and laptop.
Open the page at the top so the Algebra title is visible, and make sure the 'Take the topic test' button is not clipped (e.g. add bottom padding).
